name.description: A unique name for the trunk.

otgDtgId.description: Unique Outgoing and Destination trunk group associated with the dial plan.

linePort.description: The Line/Port identifies a device endpoint in standalone mode or a SIP URI public identity in IMS mode.

outboundProxy.description: Contains the body of the HTTP response received following the request to Console API and will not be set if the response has no body.

responseStatus.description: Present partial error/warning status information included when the http response is 206.

dualIdentitySupportEnabled.description: Determines the behavior of the From and PAI headers on outbound calls.

trunkType.description: Trunk Type associated with the trunk.

address.description: FQDN or SRV address. Required to create a static certificate-based trunk.

domain.description: Domain name. Required to create a static certificate based trunk.

port.description: FQDN port. Required to create a static certificate-based trunk.

maxConcurrentCalls.description: Max Concurrent call. Required to create a static certificate based trunk.

isRestrictedToDedicatedInstance.description: Flag to indicate if the trunk is restricted to a dedicated instance.
